skill.name: firecrawl-scraper
skill.description: Guides Firecrawl API workflows for deep web scraping, website crawling, screenshots, page interaction, and PDF parsing.
skill.summary: Use Firecrawl to extract, crawl, screenshot, and parse web content.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives in a documentation-only skill. The command finding is a Markdown installation snippet, and the network finding is a GitHub examples link. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Lines 21-23 are a fenced Markdown installation snippet, not Ruby backtick execution or automatic command execution. The command is visible documentation that a user may choose to run.
Line 31 is a documentation link to a GitHub repository for examples. It is not an outbound request or data transfer performed by the skill.

content.value_statement: Manual website collection is slow when pages need interaction, screenshots, or PDF parsing. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use Firecrawl for structured scraping and crawling tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides deep content extraction from web pages using the Firecrawl API.
Supports website crawling and batch scraping across multiple URLs.
Covers page interaction requests such as clicking and scrolling.
Supports screenshot capture for web pages and page sections.
Helps parse PDF content linked from supported web sources.
Reminds users to configure Firecrawl API keys through environment variables.
limitations: Requires a configured Firecrawl API key before use.
Results depend on target site access, rate limits, and Firecrawl availability.
Does not replace legal review for scraping permissions or terms.
Cannot guarantee extraction from every dynamic or protected page.

use_cases.title: Collect Research Sources
use_cases.description: Extract readable page content and PDFs from approved sources for faster review.

use_cases.title: Build Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Crawl multiple URLs and prepare page content for downstream processing.

use_cases.title: Capture Website Evidence
use_cases.description: Request screenshots and page data for audits, documentation, or content checks.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the firecrawl-scraper skill to extract the main content from this URL: [URL]. Return a concise summary and key links.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Page Screenshots
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl to open [URL], scroll through the page, and capture screenshots of the important sections.

prompt_templates.title: Crawl Approved URLs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firecrawl-scraper to crawl these approved URLs: [URL list]. Extract titles, main content, source URLs, and linked PDFs.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Interactive Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced page interaction and PDF parsing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Firecrawl for [URL] where content requires interaction. Click [element], scroll as needed, parse linked PDFs, and summarize evidence with source URLs.

output_examples.input: Extract the main article content from an approved documentation page.
output: Clean page title, concise summary, key sections, and source URL.
Related links and linked PDFs are listed when available.

output_examples.input: Capture a screenshot of a long landing page after scrolling.
output_examples.output: The result includes a screenshot capture plan, visible section notes, and page metadata when available.

output_examples.input: Crawl five approved product pages and compare their main claims.
output: Each page is summarized with its source URL and key claims.
The final comparison highlights repeated claims and missing details.

best_practices: Confirm that each target URL is authorized for scraping.
Configure the Firecrawl API key through environment variables.
Start with small crawl lists, then expand after checking output quality.
anti_patterns: Do not scrape private, restricted, or disallowed pages.
Do not send secrets, session cookies, or personal data into scraping requests.
Do not assume screenshots or crawls prove legal permission to reuse content.

faq.question: Does this skill require Firecrawl?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for workflows that use the Firecrawl API.

faq.question: Can it crawl multiple pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes batch scraping and website crawling use cases.

faq.question: Can it handle dynamic pages?
faq.answer: It is intended for pages that need interaction, but results depend on site behavior and Firecrawl support.

faq.question: Does it parse PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill description includes PDF parsing as a supported workflow.

faq.question: Where should I store API keys?
faq.answer: Store Firecrawl API keys in environment variables, as the skill recommends.

faq.question: Is it safe to use on any website?
faq.answer: No. Use it only where you have permission and follow site terms.
